corrected_text: LiteRT's Metal buffer handler (buffer_handler_metal.mm) locks a MetalBufferPacked buffer in shared storage in place: LiteRtLockMetalMemory returns the MTLBuffer's contents and LiteRtUnlockMetalMemory copies nothing (ours: 89137792). Other Metal buffers lock through a host shadow: the lock allocates a 64-byte-aligned host copy of packed_bytes on first lock and, for read locks, copies the GPU tensor into it (raw for a packed buffer, a direct linear copy when possible, otherwise through ML Drift descriptor conversion); write locks skip the download, and the unlock after a write copies the shadow back to the GPU tensor.
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: meaning changed. 89137792 (2026-11-13, in agello-one-20261115) added LocksInPlace (buffer_handler_metal.mm 492-503 at b7b856a0: MetalBufferPacked, MTLStorageModeShared, contents non-null, length >= packed_bytes); the lock returns [buffer contents] without a shadow (581-585) and the unlock skips the upload for it (516-519). The shadow path (587-603, then raw/direct/converted reads) is otherwise unchanged. ML Drift allocates its Metal buffers MTLResourceStorageModeShared (ml_drift/metal/buffer.mm 70-88).
